info.description: Plugin data (RuneLink links, RuneSync events) for any Discord bot. Players are seen only through the grants they make to your app; Discord ids only with their identity grant. See docs/API.md.

get.summary: A clan's polls, newest first, with options and counts
get.description: Needs the scope `polls:read`. (or polls:write). Always on. {clanId} is the hub clan id or the clan site's Discord server id. Members are the hub's people: name one with playerId (a hub player id) or discordUserId (made on first sight, so a Discord member who never signed in counts once whichever side they used). Writes need the domain's write scope and a first-party key (403 first_party_only): other apps are read-only. The writing app enforces its own Discord permissions for staff actions and may name who acted with byPlayerId or byDiscordId. Discord ids are in answers for first-party keys only. Edits take If-Match: <rev> (409 changed_elsewhere with the current item when stale). Feed kinds go to first-party apps.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes this write safe to retry: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, a new UUID per write. A repeat within 24 hours gets the first 2xx answer again (marked Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the write twice; the same key on another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused, a repeat while the first still runs is 409 idempotency_in_progress (Retry-After: 1). Refusals and failures are not kept, so a retry after one runs again. An answer showing a secret once (a webhook's signing secret) or over 1 MiB is not stored: a repeat is 409 idempotency_answer_withheld. Headers are not compared. Keys belong to the app.
